rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable evidence-supported optimizations. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is present via timeout-minutes: 30 on the job (the experiment evidence shows adding timeouts to jobs that lack them; this job already has a calibrated timeout covering setup plus Playwright's 20-minute deadline plus reporting buffer). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is present via concurrency group with cancel-in-progress: true, keyed by github.ref so distinct branches are isolated. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER is present via the pull_request paths filter on .release-please-manifest.json. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is partially present via setup-node cache: npm and the actions/cache@v6 Playwright browser cache. The remaining patterns do not fit: no matrix exists for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST or P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST; no schedule trigger exists for P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE or P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE; no Bazel build exists for the Bazel patterns; and test selection/prioritization (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT) would reduce the required full E2E test coverage. Extending P-LIT-GHA-CACHE to uv/Python dependencies is not supported because there is no Python lockfile visible to use as a cache-key input, and the evidence reports only modest aggregate benefit.
